limitations: Not executable SQL migrations or a complete OpenAPI document
No account connected or data fetched with customer credentials
No cross-client Meta training permission asserted
Phase labels do not promise all phases within 8 weeks

phases.P0: narrow direct-use carousel workflow including source-based brief options; no predictive account analytics promised
phases.P1: approved readonly account analytics and rule/baseline curation
phases.P2: bounded video editing and separately approved publishing
phases.P3: rights-cleared optional ML and controlled recommendation experiments

release_plan_precedence: Final masterplan section 07 R0/R1/R2 release definitions govern budget and schedule. P0/P1/P2/P3 are technical expansion levels, not release dates. R1 includes P0 brief_options (three customer-material proposals), 72 student hours, 24-40 expert developer hours, 6-8 designer hours, 12-16 measurement expert hours, total KRW 4.68-6.50m planning assumption.

global_conventions.tenant_resolution: authenticated membership; request tenant selector is untrusted
global_conventions.ids: UUID; no authority inferred from possession of an ID
global_conventions.rls: tenant + brand grants; application DB role is neither table owner nor superuser/BYPASSRLS; transaction-scoped tenant context
global_conventions.tenant_foreign_keys: (tenant_id, resource_id) -> (tenant_id, id); brand consistency requires explicit service/DB constraints too
global_conventions.global_catalogs: definitions only, no customer content; restricted control identities never exposed as customer directory
global_conventions.deletion: RESTRICT by default; explicit dependency-aware deletion or minimal tombstone, content is not retained merely to keep FK alive
global_conventions.append_only: business history immutable while retained; lawful deletion/purpose revocation can purge content and append audit evidence
global_conventions.logical_checks: check_contracts requiring cross-table checks are service/constraint-trigger invariants, not literal SQL CHECK expressions
global_conventions.phase_migrations: Columns and FKs referencing later-phase tables are introduced only at their introduced_in_phase; P0 is not a mandate to build all tables. Build schema migrations in dependency-aware stages.
global_conventions.idempotency: tenant+operation+key unique; request digest conflict returns 409; provider external effects still require reconciliation
global_conventions.permissions: roles are defaults, brand action grants and current provider capability are enforced at request and job execution
global_conventions.meta_default: customer-directed own-account permitted processing only; cross-client training and benchmarking denied absent separately verified authorization

retention_policies.customer_workspace: Contract-specific active use; immediate access block upon valid deletion; online deletion SLA and backup expiry must be finalized before launch
retention_policies.identity: Minimum needed for active membership and applicable legal evidence; no global customer directory
retention_policies.consent_evidence: Minimum proof with no unnecessary source content; reviewed legal retention
retention_policies.rights_evidence: Purpose/provider/license evidence while necessary; revocation affects future processing immediately
retention_policies.deletion_evidence: Minimal deletion status and lawful exceptions; no original content
retention_policies.connection: Token disabled and vault secret removed at disconnect; provider revocation attempted and logged
retention_policies.source_specific: Provider/license-specific refresh and deletion; no default indefinite retention
retention_policies.provider_specific: Current provider terms, consent and measured need; expiry enforced by adapters
retention_policies.definition_catalog: Versioned noncustomer definitions retained for interpretation
retention_policies.derived_from_sources: Cannot outlive applicable purpose/rights without independently valid basis; lineage deletion propagates
retention_policies.behavior_events: Minimum duration to evaluate stated customer workflow; cross-client sharing/training is not automatic
retention_policies.training_snapshot: Frozen reproducibility snapshot with explicit expiry and revocation; no automatic data pooling
retention_policies.model_lineage: Track affected releases; purge/retrain/disable according to valid obligations, no instant unlearning promise
retention_policies.artifact_files: Private storage; object deletion follows parent and license obligations; temporary publication URLs expire
retention_policies.run_metadata: Minimal operational metadata; ordinary diagnostic logs proposed 30 days pending policy review
retention_policies.event_metadata: Minimal permitted delivery evidence with bounded retention; no raw prompts or tokens
retention_policies.billing_minimum: Applicable legal/accounting period to be determined; content source deleted separately
retention_policies.audit_minimum: Purpose-limited security evidence; retention set before launch; no private content or tokens

apis.billing: manual text edits no AI meter; rendering allowance follows explicit plan

apis.note: Async model output can change only permitted fields; success creates a new unapproved version and preview, never overwrites the approved base.
Signed URL is issued only after auth; no permanent public object path.
Store one-use state bound to session/tenant/brand; use supported OAuth protections. Never return access tokens.

apis.permission: one-use validated OAuth state and authenticated linkage
apis.note: Server-side exchange; exact redirect allowlist; token in vault. Log redaction required.

apis.side_effect: Immediately stop local access/jobs, delete vault material and process provider revocation/deletion obligations.

apis.note: Manual import is not described as official API integration or live analytics.
No algorithm-cause or guaranteed growth claim.

apis.fallback: Editorial rules and permitted own-history baseline; label absence of account evidence.

apis.note: Server joins policy/assignment/known propensity; client cannot invent probability.

apis.side_effect: External publication only after execution-time preflight.
